title: arthrostemma glomeratum
intro: Arthrostemma glomeratum, commonly known as the "Brazilian tea" or "erva-preta", is a plant species in the family Melastomataceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The health benefits of Arthrostemma glomeratum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body.
